execution.objective: Restore the complete Member Dashboard surface coherently, including its Community preview tab and complete EN/VI/ZH localization, while preserving existing identity and invitation functionality and unrelated repository work.
pre_mutation_preservation_gate: Before snapshot creation, record the exact candidate repository absolute path, current branch, HEAD SHA, complete `git status --porcelain=v2 --branch --untracked-files=all` output, staged and unstaged tracked diffs (including binary diff representation), and a complete untracked-file inventory.
Create the preservation snapshot outside the repository in a new, uniquely named destination that must not already exist; never overwrite or reuse an earlier snapshot.

Snapshot every tracked file with staged or unstaged changes, every tracked deletion/change state, and the complete contents of every untracked file. Record repository-relative paths, file types, executable/file modes, symlink targets where applicable, byte sizes, and SHA-256 hashes in a machine-readable manifest.
Record the source SHA-256 before copying and independently hash the copied destination; record both hashes and an explicit PASS result for every copied file.

After copying, re-inventory and re-hash the source files and compare branch, HEAD, porcelain status, tracked diffs, and untracked inventory with the pre-copy record. If any source file or repository state changes during snapshot creation or verification, stop; do not proceed with application mutation.

Verify the snapshot by reading every copied file and reconciling every manifest entry, path, mode, size, and hash. Record aggregate manifest hash, verification command, timestamp, and PASS/FAIL result.

Treat the verified snapshot as immutable for the entire work cycle: no edits, renames, additions, deletions, or replacement. Verify its manifest hash again before and after candidate verification. Retain it after the work cycle; do not delete it.
Preserve the existing MemberHub.tsx changes, including sent-invitation history and deletion functionality, without reverting or replacing them.
Do not claim the historical post-corruption fix set is complete; record unresolved forensic uncertainty.
scope_requirements: Restore the eighth Community tab and its dashboard preview content.
Use the recoverable historical SllCommunityPreview presentation as the reference, retaining preview-only behavior.
Add the Community tab translation key in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese.
Audit all visible Member Dashboard text for EN/VI/ZH localization, including hardcoded labels.
Preserve existing dashboard behavior and current identity/invitation restoration.
Do not add Matrix connectivity, provisioning, synchronization, SSO, or chat embedding.
required_checks: Diff review proving existing MemberHub functionality is retained.
Localization key parity and visible-string audit for EN, VI, and ZH.
Preservation snapshot completeness, per-file hash reconciliation, immutable manifest verification, and pre/post source-state equality.
Isolated candidate build after inspection of the complete build command and dependency chain; retain logs, exit code, source manifest, and post-build live-workspace integrity evidence.

Targeted tests and reproducible baseline-versus-candidate TypeScript diagnostic comparison using identical compiler, configuration, and relevant dependencies; retain both raw outputs and diagnostic delta.
Founder visual verification of the complete dashboard in EN, VI, and ZH.
invariants: No application mutation before steward review and a separate committed activation record.
No changes outside the exact three application mutation paths.
No backend, server, database, Supabase, RLS, identity API, membership, financial, or deployment changes.
No Matrix or Element integration activation.
No reset, stash, clean, prune, backup deletion, or overwriting unrelated work.
No commit, push, pull request merge, publication, or deployment under this authority.
Stop if preservation snapshot integrity or isolated build safety cannot be established.
If any source file or repository state changes during preservation snapshot creation or verification, stop and record BLOCKED.
The preservation snapshot must be outside the repository, independently hash-verified, immutable throughout the work cycle, and retained afterward.
The isolated build must use a separate candidate environment and must not write dependencies, caches, temporary files, or generated outputs into the live workspace.
Inspect the complete build command and transitive dependency chain before execution; stop if isolation cannot be demonstrated.
Baseline and candidate TypeScript checks must use identical compiler versions, configuration, Node version, and relevant dependency set; retain raw diagnostics and the classified delta.

If implementation inspection or verification identifies a required change to SLL/Lane 1, security or dependency/Lane 2, shared runtime infrastructure, identity, membership, backend, database, or release governance outside the authorized three paths, stop. Do not make the change or expand scope. Record the finding and request separate authority.
No implementation until a separate activation record has been reviewed and approved with explicit IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORITY_ACTIVE state.
execution.verification_profile: PRESERVATION_SNAPSHOT; EXACT_THREE_PATH_SCOPE; MEMBER_DASHBOARD_LOCALIZATION; COMMUNITY_PREVIEW_ONLY; ISOLATED_BUILD; FOUNDER_VISUAL_VERIFICATION; NO_DEPLOYMENT

repository_state_capture: untracked file inventory with complete contents
verification: rehash source before and after copy
read and hash every snapshot file
reconcile paths, modes, sizes, and hashes
compare repository state before and after snapshot creation
record manifest aggregate SHA-256, timestamp, commands, and PASS/FAIL
preservation_snapshot_spec.immutability: No modification, replacement, rename, or deletion during or after the work cycle; reverify aggregate manifest hash before and after candidate verification.

isolated_build_spec.candidate_origin: Separate candidate worktree or equivalent isolated copy derived from the exact recorded baseline SHA plus only the authorized three-path candidate changes.
isolated_build_spec.live_workspace: Read-only for build execution; no dependency installation, generated output, cache, temporary file, or build artifact may be written into the live workspace.
before_execution_inspection: Inspect package.json scripts and every transitive script invoked by the proposed build command.
Inspect the package manager and lockfile, Node and package-manager versions, Vite/build configuration, TypeScript configuration, relevant plugins, and dependency lifecycle/install scripts.
Trace the complete command and dependency chain, including prebuild, postbuild, prepare, code generation, bundling, and cleanup hooks.
Record the exact command, working directory, environment variables relevant to build behavior, tool versions, lockfile hash, and expected output paths.
isolated_build_spec.dependency_boundary: Install/use dependencies only within the isolated candidate environment from the recorded lockfile; do not share writable node_modules, caches, or generated-output directories with the live workspace.
isolated_build_spec.execution_gate: Execute only after inspection demonstrates that the complete command chain remains inside the isolated candidate environment and does not invoke unrelated project-wide or destructive scripts.
evidence: candidate baseline SHA and candidate source manifest
complete build log and exit code
post-build live-workspace status proving no contamination
isolated_build_spec.failure_state: If isolation cannot be demonstrated or shared/live files could be modified, do not execute; record BLOCKED with evidence.

typescript_comparison_spec.candidate: Exact isolated candidate source manifest and candidate revision identifier.
parity_requirements: Same tsconfig and inherited configuration files, verified by path and SHA-256.
Same package manager, lockfile, and relevant dependency versions.
Same Node version and compiler invocation/flags.
evidence: baseline and candidate compiler version outputs
exact commands, working directories, timestamps, and exit codes
typescript_comparison_spec.interpretation: Classify diagnostics as pre-existing, resolved, newly introduced, or changed. Do not attribute baseline diagnostics to the candidate; do not suppress or conceal new candidate diagnostics because baseline errors exist.
typescript_comparison_spec.failure_state: If toolchain/configuration/dependency parity cannot be established, mark the comparison BLOCKED and do not claim a reproducible TypeScript result.

execution.cross_lane_stop_condition: If implementation inspection or verification identifies a required change to SLL/Lane 1, security or dependency/Lane 2, shared runtime infrastructure, identity, membership, backend, database, or release governance outside the authorized three paths, stop. Do not make the change or expand scope. Record the finding and request separate authority.
activation_record_requirements: Steward approval reference and exact approved PR head SHA.
Exact application mutation paths, with no wildcard, directory-wide, or implicit expansion.
Actual activation timestamp and expiration timestamp, no more than 14 calendar days apart.
Named execution owner and named verification owner.
Evidence-backed confirmation that the preservation gate passed, including snapshot manifest aggregate SHA-256.
Separate steward review and approval of the activation record before implementation begins.

forbidden_surface: All other application and repository paths

test_definition: Verify the complete Member Dashboard in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese.
Verify all eight tabs, including Community, render and remain navigable.
Verify Community remains a preview and exposes no Matrix destination or live integration.
Verify existing identity and invitation functionality remains intact.
Review isolated build and test evidence before any separate release decision.
